notes.title: Spooky Metroidvania Animal Well gets May 9th release date
notes.notes:
Solo developer Billy Basso's enigmatic Metroidvania Animal Well has been dated for May 9th, publishers Bigmode announced yesterday. In it, you'll explore a vast labyrinth of tunnels, solve puzzles and escape its many mammalian-based horrors, all of whom are out to gobble you up in one fell swoop - though as a strange, tiny little blob creature the size of a chicken nugget, it's unclear both what you are, and why exactly you're so appetising to them. Well, it probably has something to do with looking like a sentient chicken nugget, I suppose. Come and watch the release date trailer below.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[b]Bigmode is proud to announce the launch date for its first published title ANIMAL WELL will be Thursday, May 9, 2024.[/b]

ANIMAL WELL will be priced at $24.99/£20.99/24,50€ and will include full Steam Deck™ support!

ANIMAL WELL is the culmination of seven years of art, code, music, and game design all from one source: Billy Basso.

“I started development on ANIMAL WELL seven years ago and spent the majority of my evenings and weekends since that time working on it. I quit my day job about 2 years ago to finish the game and couldn’t be prouder of how the game turned out. This has been my passion for a long time, and I’m so excited to finally share it with the world.” -Billy Basso
